narr: An 850mb jet aided in the development of thunderstorm clusters in the morning hours of August 29th. Wind was the main threat, with some reports of flash flooding from heavy rainfall.
ev: Broadcast Media Reported roads flooded and drainage outlets overwhelmed on South Ash street in Crookston MN.
